jobs.prompt: Premium detailed grayscale anatomical fitness illustration on pure white background. Realistic adult male model, fully opaque black training T-shirt covering torso and mid-thigh shorts wrapping entire front sides back and crotch, continuous seams folds and hems, black shoes. Fine anatomical muscle contours on exposed limbs. Red target-muscle location overlay on intact shirt, never transparency or missing fabric. TWO equally sized side-by-side panels. Same model, camera, equipment and scale. Full body, hands and equipment within each panel with generous white margins. No text, captions, labels, borders or watermarks. DUMBBELL BENT OVER ROW with TWO dumbbells simultaneously, not a bench-supported one-arm row. Side three-quarter view showing both arms and upper back. Both poses maintain stable hip hinge, neutral spine/neck, knees slightly bent, feet grounded. Left: arms hang down under shoulders, palms face each other. Right: bend both elbows to row dumbbells toward lower ribs, elbows pass torso, wrists neutral; do not stand up or change torso angle. Red overlay upper-back region over intact shirt.
jobs.inspectionNote: Visible clothing intact; full body/equipment framed; lowered and raised poses distinct. Qualified anatomical and exercise-technique review remains required.
blockingIssues: Verify neutral-grip wrist orientation, torso stability and upper-back highlight boundaries; side view overlaps far hand/equipment.
